speaker: YUNA
text: Vanakkam! Welcome to a traditional South Indian village house.

speaker: ANNA
text: Good morning, dear visitor. Our walls are warm cream, and the scent of jasmine fills the air.

speaker: KUMAR
text: Look, Grandma! The mango tree outside is blooming again!

speaker: ANNA
text: Yes, Kumar. That tree has guarded our family for generations. Let me tell you its story...

speaker: YUNA
text: As the sun sets, the village gathers to share blessings, honoring tradition and unity.
